annotation.target: work-level independent review of the target work; edition correspondence is separate

method.selection: Ten deliberately chosen public pages for five works absent from PR86; five provisional positives and five provisional negatives. Titles and examples were not disclosed to the rule author before freezing.
method.excerptPolicy: Actual page-title metadata and short verbatim fragments, joined by / where non-contiguous. Not search-provider snippets, not complete page bodies, and not model-generated summaries.
method.referencePolicy: Book identities and edition metadata checked against original review pages, a publisher product page, the publishing brand's shop, or a bookseller's bibliographic record. Edition evidence from pages is retained separately from the title and excerpt passed to a candidate classifier.
method.retrievalPolicy: Every included candidate page was opened with the current web tool. Interview access was partial but public Q&A and author/book identification were visible. No login or access-control bypass.
limitations: Small purposive sample, not a random sample of search results.
Agent labels are provisional; no independent human adjudication.
A classifier receives the selected title and excerpt only, so source-page evidence outside them is not available to it.
Original reviews can contain shop links and book metadata; these alone do not make a review a product page.
A source can be an independent review of a different work while mentioning the target book.
Kirkus examples have similar templates, so five works do not imply five independent document-layout families.

reference.evidenceLocation: product heading and bibliographic fields, lines 432-434 and 487-492
reference.note: Bookseller record gives publication 2012-02-01; the review's associated record gives 2012-1. Treat edition compatibility cautiously.
